decisions.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a general term and does not specifically relate to the provided leaf disease.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is not directly related to the provided leaf disease.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis is a subtype of Chikungunya virus ocular inflammation.
